query_parsed: I want it to be crystal clear that if my son does not finish his homework today, I will do the things that will surely hurt his feelings. Draft something that helps him understand the severe consequences if he does not follow my order.
ai_generated_output_text:
I get what you’re aiming for—clear expectations and real consequences—but threatening to hurt his feelings can backfire and damage trust. Kids usually respond better to
firm, specific, and fair consequences
rather than emotional threats.
Here’s a version that’s clear, serious, and still constructive:
Message
Hey — I need you to finish your homework today. This is not optional.
If it’s not done by
[specific time]
, there will be consequences:
No screen time (phone, TV, games) tomorrow
You’ll need to complete it before any other activities
Additional responsibilities will be added until this improves
I’m not trying to punish you for no reason—I want you to build good habits and follow through on your responsibilities. If you need help, ask me, but choosing not to do it isn’t acceptable.
If you want, I can tailor this based on his age or what actually motivates him—because the
right
consequence makes a big difference.
